digest_definition: SHA256 sorted relative-path + NUL + file/symlink kind + NUL + original file bytes or symlink target + NUL; same evaluated exclusions.
excluded_generated_material: Only the original evaluator's digest exclusions. No dependency cache, dist tree, run output or credentials copied. Upstream build/ source scripts, documentation assets and intentional vendor code are retained.
identity_policy: Historical evaluated input and component digests identify the measured runs. Public archive YAML and task digests identify the released bytes after private-path redaction and lossless image-metadata removal; the original private paths cannot be reconstructed from this export.
